title: Queued application-send residence diagnostics work item
summary: Preserve first-enqueue age and bounded initial cause for queued application sends, and expose per-cause retention diagnostics without changing runtime scheduling.
planned_changes: Add first-enqueue elapsed time and bounded cause to pending application sends, preserve them through replacement and fragmentation, emit enabled-only per-cause retention measurements, add focused ownership/age/metrics tests, and extend ProtocolLab parsing only after the transport shape is proven.
verification_plan: Run focused queue and MeterListener tests, the complete QUIC suite, SpecTrace validation, one source-backed c16/c32 counter run, and a clean repeated source-backed campaign to prove disabled-instrument neutrality.
